source_excerpt: The product shall ensure that it can only be accessed by authorized users.  The product will be able to distinguish between authorized and unauthorized users in all access attempts

evidence_span.text: only be accessed by authorized users
distinguish between authorized and unauthorized users

clean_requirement: The product shall grant access only when the user is authorized; unauthorized users shall be denied.
smelly_requirement: The product shall distinguish between authorized and unauthorized users in every access attempt.
removed_condition: The enforcement outcome that denies unauthorized users is omitted; classification alone is not access control.
contamination_notes: The source contains both an access-control statement and a classification statement. The smelly mutation keeps the classification idea but removes the observable deny decision, isolating an incompleteness/loophole contrast.
licensing_notes: The ARTA repository is MIT-licensed, but the original NFR document and its individual requirement texts may have separate terms. This record stores the excerpt for research provenance; redistribution and publication of the full source corpus require a separate license check.
